# Synthetic fixture

`synthetic_travel_bookings.csv` contains 200 deterministic, fictional records generated by `scripts/generate_synthetic_fixture.py` with seed `20260813`. No customer data is present.

For future discovery development it embeds an artificial interaction: `discount > 0.10 AND booking_lead_time < 21 AND supplier = BlueWing` increases additional cost and cancellation probability and lowers contribution/gross margin. This is fixture documentation, not an implemented discovery claim.
